action_summary: Round 18's nominated next organ was a format hypothesis; round 19 measured the cheaper explanation first and killed it. Both engines had been fed only the 5-6 literal arguments recoverable from the one test a fix touches, so this round harvests what the repositories already ship -- 5949 documents, test string literals and the projects' own data files -- distils them by measured coverage, and hands them to both engines UNCHANGED. Result over the same 8 unpinned parts: 2 pinned with the tests' literals, 1 pinned with the repository corpus at the same budget, 1 pinned with the budget scaled to the seeds (600 executions), 0 gained and one LOST to dilution (6 seeds pin a part that 46 do not). Both defects found in this round's own instrument were fixed before the zero was believed: a ranking of `prefer - length` that put one-line fragments ahead of real documents, and a distillation that replaced the proven seeds instead of unioning with them (replacement cost one pin). The measured bottleneck is therefore not seed supply, not reachability machinery, and not the format organ: it is that the search has NO per-gate objective -- it retains by line novelty, cannot say which candidate is one guard closer, and so cannot survive a larger corpus.
